name: Mai Rental
source:
Main character receives an e-mail with internet site address where it's possible to rent imouto for one day. Site presents two customizable models of androids. Price is good, so protagonist decides to place an order and try it out.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-january-2007-gekkou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
